name: Liam O'Connell
bio:
Liam's journey into motorsport was a bit unconventional. After serving an apprenticeship as a panel beater, a chance encounter with a restoration project for a vintage rally car ignited a passion for precision and finish. He quickly became renowned for his meticulous attention to detail, landing a role at a local racing team before making the move to McLaren. 

At McLaren, Liam thrives in the fast-paced environment. His approach is a blend of traditional techniques and modern innovations, always striving for the perfect blend of aesthetics and performance. He believes a flawless paint job is not just cosmetic; it's a reflection of the team's commitment to excellence, and a subtle advantage on the track. Liam’s ability to color match with incredible accuracy is legendary within the team.

physical.description: Liam is a sturdy man of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always polishes his tools before and after use.
Has a collection of miniature vintage race cars on his workbench.
Meticulously labels every paint can with the exact date and time of mixing.
